# cli/

<!-- Generated by `node cli/roster.mjs --write` from the files it lists: never edit it by hand. The
     `tests` recipe is red while it differs from that render (cli-roster.live.test.mjs). -->

The command line of the npm package. `portulan <subcommand>` reaches each subcommand through
`package.json`'s `bin`, [`portulan.mjs`](portulan.mjs); every tool here also runs from a clone as
`node cli/<file>.mjs`. A subcommand's line is its `portulan --help` summary, and every other line is the
first paragraph of its file's header comment, which says what the file is. The groups come from the
code: `SUBCOMMANDS` in [`portulan.mjs`](portulan.mjs), `HOOK_RUNNERS` in [`compile.mjs`](compile.mjs),
and `EXCLUDED` in [`payload.mjs`](payload.mjs), which says why each file marked *Not shipped* stays home.

A tool belongs here when it works on any workspace or plugin root. This repository's own recipes live
in [`../.portulan/verify/`](../.portulan/verify/), and its operator tooling in
[`../.portulan/tools/`](../.portulan/tools/).

## What is here today

### The entry point and its subcommands

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`portulan.mjs`](portulan.mjs) | Portulan — the one entry point the `npx` package exposes. |
| [`init.mjs`](init.mjs) | `portulan init`: draft a workspace for a repository that has none. |
| [`doctor.mjs`](doctor.mjs) | `portulan doctor`: validate a workspace against the Workspace Definition. |
| [`compile.mjs`](compile.mjs) | `portulan compile`: compile a workspace's gate policy into host enforcement. |
| [`vendor.mjs`](vendor.mjs) | `portulan vendor`: materialise a workspace where it is needed: into a host, or between residences. |
| [`index.mjs`](index.mjs) | `portulan index`: regenerate the memory, handoff and scope indexes. |
| [`upgrade.mjs`](upgrade.mjs) | `portulan upgrade`: migrate a workspace: the Workspace Definition steps it owes, and the repairs a rewriter owes it. |
| [`new.mjs`](new.mjs) | `portulan new`: scaffold a skill, persona, pack, workspace, gate policy or repo card from a core template. |
| [`feedback.mjs`](feedback.mjs) | `portulan feedback`: file an issue from a report you previewed, seam-scanned before it leaves the machine. |

### Hook runners

Run by the hooks `compile` writes into a host's settings, never by a person.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`gate.mjs`](gate.mjs) | The PreToolUse gate runner — the *explanation* half of the enforcement compiler. |
| [`stop-gate.mjs`](stop-gate.mjs) | The Stop-gate runner — "done" is not a thing an agent may simply declare. |
| [`advisory.mjs`](advisory.mjs) | The restart advisory — one line, once, where the agent is, and the same figure for the human. |
